row.notes: If item+0x17c == 1 it formats *value to text through type desc 0x14612bd40 (vtbl+0x8/+0x40/+0x28), makes an NeStr, resolves the string node named by item+0x80 under the handle at parent+0x8 (Game_VmBinding_ResolveStringNode) and sets it with Vm_NodeSet_String. Otherwise it resolves the typed node of the same name (Game_VmBinding_ResolveTypedNode) and, when the node type matches desc 0x14612bd40 and the stored int differs, writes *value and fires the change listeners (inlined set-if-changed). Vm_TeamHqFinances_Refresh and caller 0x14230a6e0 (fills per-row values) call it in loops with the item returned by Vm_Add_ChildItem_Size208 and an int read from another node.
